0022600026.text: The Celtics come in at 5-2 and sit second in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, after a loss in their most recent game, while the Hornets are 3-5, on a four-game losing streak, and ninth in the East. Boston is without Jayson Tatum (rest) and Devin Carter (illness), and Charlotte is without Grant Williams (hamstring). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Celtics won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 113-102 win in Boston on April 7, 2026.
